Bachelor's degree in a related field. Master's degree or CPA preferred.

Job Summary/Basic Functions

The AVP, Finance responsible for analysis and assistance with the maintenance of the University’s general ledger trial balance, revenue/expenditure reporting, cash management services, EKU Foundation operations, financial audits and overall financial management and budget. Responsible for financial/budget oversight and guidance to all auxiliary service operations. Overall management of many University business contracts and administrative units. Select duties will be more defined.

Minimum Qualifications

Education:
B.S. Degree in Accounting, Business, Finance, or other business related, relevant field is required. An MBA and/or CPA is preferred.

Experience:
Five years or more of appropriate, applicable experience in college/university or governmental business services/operations; and/or administration.

Job Duties

50% - Responsible for analysis and assistance with the maintenance of the University’s general ledger trial balance, revenue/expenditure reporting, cash management services, EKU Foundation operations, financial audits and overall financial management and budget. - (Essential)
30% - Responsible for financial/budget oversight and guidance to all auxiliary service operations. - (Essential)
